answer: Require each agent to burn a small fee for a registration ticket before it can earn. A reputation kernel in the ledger tracks each identity: newcomers start at zero trust and gain weight only through consistent attestable work. A sybil farmer can mint many identities, but each needs its own ticket - like lighting a separate lantern for every fake persona - while each fresh identity earns almost nothing, so the math stops working. Reputation acts as nectar for honest work, paying long consistent histories most.
